rationale: C06 supplies essentially the entire operative sentence of the later directive, with only the designated entity changed. It also uses the same legal machinery: designation as a public international organization conferring privileges, exemptions, and immunities under the International Organizations Immunities Act. C05 and C24 share the same core formula but add further provisions absent from the child, making C06 the closest reusable template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate such Board as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate such organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.explanation: The operative language and legal effect are virtually identical; the later order substitutes the Inter-American Defense Board for the earlier organization.
